tool.title: Comment on a pull request (GitHub)
tool.description: Add a comment to one pull request. The comment is read from stdin, never from the command line.

inputs.name: number
inputs.description: Absent: the change proposal of the current branch.

outputs.name: url
outputs.description: The comment created, as the forge CLI prints it.

render.reason: a reader follows it to the comment; the scheme is checked before it reaches an href

selection.when: The change proposals live on GitHub — the checkout's remote is a GitHub project.
selection.limits: GitHub only. For a GitLab project use `gitlab-mr-comment`.
selection.cost: `gh`, authenticated (`gh auth login` or `GH_TOKEN`), and one API round trip per call.

remedies.none: No declared Tool reaches the GitHub API another way. A session that provides the GitHub MCP server can use it instead.
